question: In a certain code language, 'SQUARE' is written as 'UQSERA'. How will 'CAREER' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

'SQUARE' is written as 'UQSERA'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/019e01bb999fa7c9261da5825ac4a7b5478d6cf8a616afb1c3e2c5f2f2da1167.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6befba6a69f4aa4c5001324711ca79f66011ff234f0d37ecd3d49be9561c33c5.png] 

Similarly,

'CAREER' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acf5cbd795401329787ff2b260bd73103a961b8f457fcba1f422809d1343412e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/481b58f30d315dbfe6a3390f452cbeeae694d64c88c7cd02d279875f19c9ab2c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"RACREE".**
